profile_text.body:
Hesai Group is a Shanghai-headquartered public company, listed under the ticker HSAI and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001861737. It describes itself as a global leader in 3D perception and a lidar manufacturer, saying its sensors serve ADAS, autonomous vehicles, trucking, robotics, and industrial applications. The company says it works with automotive OEMs, autonomous vehicle companies, and robotics companies worldwide and has delivered mass-produced lidars to customers in over 40 countries.

According to its site, Hesai's lidars act as the eyes of intelligent vehicles, providing high-resolution 3D perception that supports features such as AEB (Automated Emergency Braking) and NOA (Navigation on Autopilot) as well as advanced semi-autonomous driving. It also says it supplies sensors meeting the standards for L4+ autonomous driving, aimed at robotaxis, robobuses, and other autonomous fleets operating with little to no human input. The company frames its work as enabling physical AI across ADAS, autonomous mobility, robotics, and spatial intelligence.

Beyond the company profile, the available material is limited: no litigation and no specific product entries are recorded alongside it.
